title: What freezing cold does
description:
Stage by stage, how your body fights to stay warm as the cold sets in.
#cold #hypothermia #science #body
AI-free animation made with code. Not medical advice.

lines.hook: What happens if you stay out in freezing cold?
lines.b1: In freezing air, your body starts shivering to make heat.
lines.b2: Blood vessels in your skin narrow, so your fingers go numb.
lines.b3: Below thirty-five degrees, doctors call it hypothermia.
lines.b4: Around thirty-three degrees, you get clumsy and confused.
lines.b5: Near thirty-two degrees, shivering can stop, and your heart slows down.
lines.end: So, how do you stay warm when it's freezing?
